profileEvidence.summary: Territorial and watchful, the Sardinian Shepherd Dog is known locally as the Cane Fonnese. Its guarding instinct and wariness of strangers reflect work protecting flocks and property. Sardinian keepers long selected these dogs for working ability and behavior, so the population retained considerable variation in appearance before a provisional standard was drawn up.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A territorial Sardinian flock and property guardian, the Cane Fonnese was long selected for work and remains wary of strangers.
